# Periodic Notes

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Manage daily, weekly, and monthly notes.

## Scope note

Extends the core plugin for Daily Notes to include other time horizons: Week, Month, Quarter, and Year.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
